requirements.title: The ruleset
requirements.rationale: The ruleset grants exactly the access tools need, and nothing else, so that execute and its children cannot write outside the workspace and the agent's private directories.

criteria.action: grant every filesystem access right the applied ABI defines, including execute, refer at ABI 2 and later and truncate at ABI 3 and later, beneath each writable root: the workspace given by --workdir, HOME from the agent's environment, the temporary directory resolved exactly as 13's agent resolves its default spill location, and each --landlock-rw path
criteria.contract: a process under the ruleset can create, rename across directories, truncate and execute files beneath every writable root

setup: directories W, H, T, R and O created under t.TempDir()
inputs: workdir W, explicit env HOME=H and TMPDIR=T, --landlock-rw R, --landlock-ro O, --network unrestricted
the confine package's rule-building step, called directly from its own tests without applying anything, for applied ABI 2, 3 and 4
Linux; the test's independent probe (syscall 444 with LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION) reports kernel ABI 2 or later, else the test skips naming the ABI or error it found
directories W, H, T, R and O, a sibling directory S outside all of them holding S/secret, and O/ro.txt, all created by the parent
the test binary re-executed as a child with an environment marker selecting this case, so that the ruleset confines only the child
check.pseudocode:
for abi in [2,3,4]:
  r = buildRules(inputs{Workdir:W, Env:['HOME='+H,'TMPDIR='+T], RW:[R], RO:[O], Mode:Unrestricted}, abi)
  assert set(r.Writable) == {W,H,T,R} ∪ existing(devices)
  assert set(r.ReadOnly) == existing(systemDirs) ∪ {O,'/proc'}
  for rule in r.rules where rule.root in {W,H,T,R}: assert rule.access == fullFS(abi)  // refer from 2, truncate from 3
  for rule in system ∪ {O}: assert rule.access == {ReadFile,ReadDir,Execute}
  assert rule('/proc').access == {ReadFile,ReadDir}; for d in devices: assert {ReadFile,WriteFile} ⊆ rule(d).access && Execute ∉ rule(d).access && no dir right
if probeKernel() < 2: t.Skipf('kernel Landlock ABI %d < 2', k)
child(case='fs'):
  info,err = confine.Setup(W, env, rw=[R], ro=[O], Unrestricted); assert err==nil && info.ABI>=2
  for d in [W,H,T,R]: assert create(d+'/x')==nil
  assert rename(W+'/a/f', W+'/b/f')==nil; if info.ABI>=3: assert truncate(W+'/b/f',0)==nil
  writeExec(W+'/s.sh'); assert run(W+'/s.sh')==0
  for p in [S+'/new', O+'/new']: assert errors.Is(create(p), EACCES)
  assert errors.Is(writeFile('/proc/self/comm','x'), EACCES); assert errors.Is(readFile(S+'/secret'), EACCES)
  assert readFile(O+'/ro.txt')==nil && run('/bin/sh','-c','true')==0 && readFile('/proc/self/status')==nil && run('/bin/sh','-c','echo x > /dev/null')==0
  print(marker); exit 0
parent: assert exit==0 && contains(out, marker)

criteria.action: grant read and execute beneath /usr, /bin, /sbin, /lib, /lib32, /lib64, /libx32, /etc, /opt and each --landlock-ro path, read only beneath /proc, read and write on the device files /dev/null, /dev/zero, /dev/full, /dev/random and /dev/urandom, and no other filesystem access
criteria.contract: a process under the ruleset that creates a file outside every writable root, or reads a file outside every listed root, fails with EACCES

criteria.condition: the agent runs with --network none and the applied ABI is 4
criteria.action: handle TCP bind and TCP connect in the ruleset and grant no port, so that every TCP bind and connect from the agent and its children is denied, loopback included
criteria.contract: the report's TCP is true; a TCP connect to a listener on 127.0.0.1 fails

setup: Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 4 or later by the test's independent probe, else a skip naming the ABI found
a TCP listener the parent opened on 127.0.0.1:0, its address passed to the child
one re-executed child per network mode

criteria.condition: the agent runs with --network allowlist or --network unrestricted
criteria.action: handle no network access right in the ruleset, leaving TCP to the provider
criteria.contract: the report's TCP is false; a TCP connect to a listener on 127.0.0.1 succeeds

criteria.condition: a system directory, a device file, or a --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw path does not exist
criteria.action: skip that path and apply the rest of the ruleset, silently for a system or device path and with a note naming the path for a flag path
criteria.contract: the path is absent from Writable and ReadOnly, the apply succeeds, and Note names every skipped --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw path

setup: the system-directory and device-file lists, replaceable in the confine package's own tests, extended with /nonexistent-agentkit-sys and /dev/nonexistent-agentkit
absolute paths M1 and M2 under t.TempDir() that do not exist, passed as --landlock-ro M1 and --landlock-rw M2, with a valid workdir W
check.pseudocode:
withSystemDirs(append(sys,'/nonexistent-agentkit-sys')); withDevices(append(dev,'/dev/nonexistent-agentkit'))
r,err = buildRules(inputs{Workdir:W, RO:[M1], RW:[M2]}, 4); assert err==nil
for p in [M1,M2,'/nonexistent-agentkit-sys','/dev/nonexistent-agentkit']: assert p ∉ r.Writable ∪ r.ReadOnly
assert contains(r.Note,M1) && contains(r.Note,M2) && !contains(r.Note,'nonexistent-agentkit-sys') && !contains(r.Note,'/dev/nonexistent-agentkit')
if linux && probeKernel()>=2: child: _,err = confine.Setup(same); assert err==nil && create(W+'/x')==nil

criteria.condition: HOME or the temporary directory is unset, relative, missing, equal to `/`, or equal to or an ancestor of a system directory
criteria.action: skip that root and apply the rest of the ruleset
criteria.contract: the root is absent from Writable, the agent starts and serves, and Note names the skipped variable and the reason it was skipped

setup: a valid workdir W, a symlink L under t.TempDir() pointing to /usr, and a missing path X under t.TempDir()
the confine package's report-building step, and for the last case the built agentkit-sandboxd
check.pseudocode:
for c in cases: r,err = buildRules(inputs{Workdir:W, Env:c.env}, 4); assert err==nil
  assert c.root ∉ r.Writable && resolved(c.root) ∉ r.Writable && W ∈ r.Writable
  assert contains(r.Note, c.var) && (c.unset ? contains(r.Note,'unset') : contains(r.Note, c.value))
if linux && probeKernel()>=2: p = start(bin,'--workdir',W, env=['HOME=/','TMPDIR='+X,'PATH=/usr/bin:/bin']); sb = attachTo(p)
  l = sb.Agent().Landlock; assert l.ABI>0 && '/' ∉ l.Writable && X ∉ l.Writable && contains(l.Note,'HOME') && contains(l.Note,'TMPDIR')

criteria.condition: --workdir or a --landlock-rw path is `/` or equal to or an ancestor of a system directory, or a --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw path is relative
criteria.action: refuse to start, applying no ruleset and serving nothing
criteria.contract: exit status 2 and one line on stderr naming the offending flag

setup: the agentkit-sandboxd binary built into t.TempDir(), run on Linux and macOS
a symlink L under t.TempDir() that points to /usr
check.pseudocode:
for (args, flag) in [(['--workdir','/'],'--workdir'), (['--workdir','/usr'],'--workdir'), (['--workdir',L],'--workdir'), (['--landlock-rw','/'],'--landlock-rw'), (['--landlock-rw','/opt'],'--landlock-rw'), (['--landlock-rw','rel/dir'],'--landlock-rw'), (['--landlock-ro','rel/dir'],'--landlock-ro')]:
  so,se,code = run(bin, args...); assert code==2 && countLines(trim(se))==1 && contains(se, flag) && so==''

criteria.action: for any set of roots, resolve each root with filepath.EvalSymlinks before adding its rule, collapse roots that resolve to the same path into one rule, and list the resolved paths in the report's Writable and ReadOnly in the order their rules were added, with the device files under Writable and /proc under ReadOnly
criteria.contract: Writable and ReadOnly contain no duplicate and no unresolved symlink path

setup: a seeded generator of directory trees under t.TempDir() with real directories, symlinks to them, chains of symlinks, trailing slashes and .. components
the confine package's report-building step
check.pseudocode:
for seed in 1..200: tree = genTree(seed); in = genInputs(tree, seed)
  r,err = buildRules(in, 4); assert err==nil
  assert noDup(r.Writable) && noDup(r.ReadOnly)
  for e in r.Writable ∪ r.ReadOnly: assert evalSymlinks(e)==e
  assert without(r.Writable, devices) == dedupFirst(map(resolve, rwOrder(in)))
  assert without(r.ReadOnly, systemDirs ∪ {'/proc'}) == dedupFirst(map(resolve, in.RO)) && '/proc' ∈ r.ReadOnly && '/proc' ∉ r.Writable
  assert len(r.rules) == len(distinct(resolved roots))

requirements.title: Choosing and applying the ABI
requirements.rationale: An explicit, reported choice of ABI replaces BestEffort's silent downgrade, keeps the floor at ABI 2 so git keeps working, and makes a refused apply fatal instead of serving unconfined.

criteria.action: for any kernel ABI from 0 to 8, a probe error, and each of the network modes none, allowlist and unrestricted, make Plan(kernelABI, probeErr, mode) return: after a probe error, ABI 0, TCP false and the note `Landlock unavailable: <error>`; for kernel ABI 0, ABI 0, TCP false and `kernel reports no Landlock support`; for kernel ABI 1, ABI 0, TCP false and `kernel Landlock ABI 1 cannot permit cross-directory renames (needs ABI 2, Linux 5.19); not applied`; for kernel ABI 2 or 3, the kernel's ABI, TCP false and, under none, `kernel Landlock ABI k cannot restrict TCP (needs ABI 4, Linux 6.7)`; for kernel ABI 4 or later, ABI 4, TCP true only under none, and an empty note under none and unrestricted
criteria.contract: probe error: ABI 0, TCP false, note `Landlock unavailable: boom`; kernel 0: ABI 0, TCP false, note `kernel reports no Landlock support`; kernel 1: ABI 0, TCP false, note `kernel Landlock ABI 1 cannot permit cross-directory renames (needs ABI 2, Linux 5.19); not applied` (all three in every mode); kernel 2 or 3: ABI equals the kernel ABI and TCP is false; under none the note is exactly `kernel Landlock ABI k cannot restrict TCP (needs ABI 4, Linux 6.7)` with k the kernel ABI; kernel 4 to 8: ABI 4; TCP is true under none and false otherwise; the note is empty under none and under unrestricted; under allowlist at every input whose applied ABI is above 0 (kernel 2 to 8), TCP is false and the note states that Landlock cannot express a host allowlist and that TCP is left to the provider (it contains `allowlist` and `provider`)

setup: confine.Plan, called from a test file with no build constraint so that it runs on every platform

criteria.condition: the network mode is allowlist and Plan's applied ABI is above 0
criteria.action: make Plan's note state that Landlock cannot express a host allowlist and that TCP is left to the provider
criteria.contract: TCP is false and the note contains both statements

criteria.action: keep Plan a pure function in a file with no build constraint, so that it compiles and is tested on every platform, and probe the kernel's Landlock ABI exactly once per process through a probe function that tests replace via an unexported seam to simulate kernel ABI 1 to 3 and probe errors
criteria.contract: the file declaring Plan has no //go:build line and no GOOS or GOARCH file-name suffix, and neither does the test file exercising it; each call of the entry point invokes the fake exactly once, although both Plan and the report need its value; with the fake returning 1 or an error the outcome has ABI 0 and no ruleset is applied: the re-executed child performing those calls can still create a file outside every root afterwards; with 2 or 3 the outcome's ABI equals the simulated value (applied in a re-executed child on a kernel of at least that ABI, skipped otherwise)

setup: the confine package's source files parsed with go/parser and go/build/constraint
the unexported probe seam replaced by a counting fake in the package's tests
check.pseudocode:
f = fileDeclaring('Plan'); assert buildConstraint(f)==nil && !hasGOOSSuffix(f) && buildConstraint(testFileOf(f))==nil
child: n=0; withProbe(func(){n++; return v, e})
  for (v,e) in [(1,nil),(0,ENOSYS)]: n=0; info,_ = Setup(...); assert n==1 && info.ABI==0; assert create(outside)==nil
if probeKernel()>=3: child: for v in [2,3]: n=0; info,_=Setup(...); assert n==1 && info.ABI==v

criteria.condition: Plan returns an applied ABI above 0
criteria.action: apply a go-landlock configuration of exactly that version (V2, V3 or V4) carrying the ruleset of 15-REQ-1, through Restrict when TCP is true and RestrictPaths otherwise, setting no_new_privs on all threads as part of applying, and never calling BestEffort
criteria.contract: after the call returns nil, every thread of the agent and every process it starts is confined and PR_GET_NO_NEW_PRIVS returns 1

setup: Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 2 or later by the test's independent probe, else a skip naming the ABI
re-executed children, a sibling directory S outside every root, a --landlock-ro root O holding O/f, and a loopback listener opened by the parent
check.pseudocode:
child(threads): ch=make(chan struct{}); res=make(chan error); go func(){runtime.LockOSThread(); <-ch; res <- create(S+'/x')}()
  info,err = Setup(...); assert err==nil && prctl(PR_GET_NO_NEW_PRIVS)==1
  close(ch); assert errors.Is(<-res, EACCES); assert run('/bin/sh','-c','touch '+S+'/y')!=0 && !exists(S+'/y')
if k>=3: child: withProbe(2); Setup(ro=[O]); assert truncate(O+'/f',0)==nil && errors.Is(create(O+'/new'),EACCES)
  child: withProbe(3); Setup(ro=[O]); assert errors.Is(truncate(O+'/f',0),EACCES)
if k>=4: child: withProbe(3); info,_=Setup(mode=none); assert !info.TCP && dial(ln.Addr())==nil

criteria.condition: the probe fails, for example with ENOSYS, EOPNOTSUPP or a seccomp EPERM
criteria.action: continue without applying a ruleset
criteria.contract: the agent serves, and its report has ABI 0, KernelABI 0, TCP false and the note `Landlock unavailable: <error>`

setup: the probe seam replaced by a fake returning syscall.ENOSYS, syscall.EOPNOTSUPP and syscall.EPERM in turn, inside a re-executed child
an agent.Agent served over net.Pipe and reached through attach.Dial
check.pseudocode:
child: for e in [ENOSYS, EOPNOTSUPP, EPERM]: withProbe(0, e); info,err = Setup(...)
  assert err==nil && info.ABI==0 && info.KernelABI==0 && !info.TCP && info.Note=='Landlock unavailable: '+e.Error() && len(info.Writable)==0 && len(info.ReadOnly)==0
  assert create(outside)==nil && dial(loopback)==nil; printJSON(info)
parent: a = agent.New(agent.Config{Workdir:t.TempDir(), TTL:time.Hour, Landlock:info}); sb = attachOverPipe(a); assert reflect.DeepEqual(sb.Agent().Landlock, info)

criteria.condition: building or applying the ruleset fails after a successful probe
criteria.action: exit without serving any RPC
criteria.contract: exactly one line `agentkit-sandboxd: landlock: <cause>` on stderr and exit status 1

setup: Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 2 or later, the test not running as root (else a skip naming the reason)
the built agentkit-sandboxd and a directory P with mode 000 so that the absolute path P/sub cannot be resolved (EACCES, not ENOENT)
in the confine package, on a kernel offering exactly ABI 2 or 3, a re-executed child with the probe seam reporting 4
check.pseudocode:
if os.Getuid()==0: t.Skip('root bypasses the mode-000 directory'); mkdir(P,0o000)
p = start(bin,'--workdir',W,'--landlock-ro',P+'/sub'); _,err = attachTo(p); assert err!=nil
assert p.Wait().ExitCode()==1; se=stderr(p); assert countLines(trim(se))==1 && strings.HasPrefix(se,'agentkit-sandboxd: landlock: ') && stdout(p)==''
if k in [2,3]: child: withProbe(4); _,err = Setup(...); assert err!=nil

criteria.condition: the agent is built for a GOOS other than linux
criteria.action: apply nothing, through a !linux stub that imports no go-landlock package
criteria.contract: the report has ABI 0, KernelABI 0, TCP false and the note `Landlock is Linux-only (GOOS=<os>)`

setup: the confine package's non-test files parsed with go/parser and go/build/constraint
a `//go:build !linux` test file run on a macOS or Windows host, and the cross-target vet for darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64

criteria.action: report the ABI the probe returned as KernelABI, unchanged by the cap at 4, and 0 after a probe error
criteria.contract: kernel ABI 6 under none gives ABI 4, KernelABI 6 and TCP true

setup: the confine package's step that combines the probe result with Plan into a LandlockInfo before applying, with the probe seam replaced by a fake
check.pseudocode:
for (v,e,mode,want) in [(6,nil,none,{4,6,true}), (8,nil,unrestricted,{4,8,false}), (3,nil,none,{3,3,false}), (1,nil,none,{0,1,false}), (0,ENOSYS,none,{0,0,false})]:
  withProbe(v,e); info = outcome(inputs, mode); assert (info.ABI,info.KernelABI,info.TCP)==want

requirements.title: The command, its flags and its start-up order
requirements.rationale: The agent cannot infer the network mode, a missing flag must narrow the boundary rather than widen it, and confinement must precede every other piece of work.

criteria.action: accept, besides 13's --workdir, --ttl and --version, exactly the flags --network none|allowlist|unrestricted (default none), --landlock-ro PATH and --landlock-rw PATH, the last two repeatable, and no flag that disables or weakens confinement
criteria.contract: parseFlags with no --network yields mode none; each repeated --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw value is kept in command-line order

setup: the command's parseFlags exercised in-package
check.pseudocode:
cfg,_ = parseFlags([]); assert cfg.Network==sandbox.NetworkNone
for m in ['allowlist','unrestricted']: cfg,_ = parseFlags(['--network',m]); assert cfg.Network.String()==m
cfg,err = parseFlags(['--landlock-ro','/a','--landlock-rw','/x','--landlock-ro','/b','--landlock-rw','/y']); assert err==nil && cfg.LandlockRO==['/a','/b'] && cfg.LandlockRW==['/x','/y']
assert flagNames(newFlagSet()) == {'workdir','ttl','version','network','landlock-ro','landlock-rw'}

criteria.condition: --network has a value other than none, allowlist or unrestricted
criteria.action: refuse to start without applying a ruleset or serving
criteria.contract: exit status 2 and one line on stderr naming --network

setup: the agentkit-sandboxd binary built into t.TempDir()
check.pseudocode: for v in ['bogus','','NONE']: so,se,code = run(bin,'--network',v); assert code==2 && countLines(trim(se))==1 && contains(se,'--network') && so==''

criteria.condition: agentkit-sandboxd is run with --version
criteria.action: print the agent version and `(protocol 1.2)` without probing or applying Landlock and without serving
criteria.contract: stdout contains `(protocol 1.2)`; exit status 0

setup: the agentkit-sandboxd binary built into t.TempDir(); TS-13-24 updated to expect `1.2`
check.pseudocode: for args in [['--version'], ['--version','--network','none','--landlock-ro','/usr']]: so,se,code = run(bin,args...); assert code==0 && contains(so,'(protocol 1.2)') && contains(so, expectedVersion) && se==''

criteria.action: in main, parse the flags, then handle --version, then compute and apply the ruleset, and only then redirect stdout, call agent.New, start any goroutine of its own and serve
criteria.contract: an AST test over the command's source fails, naming the file and line, if a call to redirectStdout or agent.New, or a go statement, precedes the confinement call in main

setup: the non-test Go files of sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd parsed with go/parser
synthetic sources in which agent.New, redirectStdout or a go statement precedes the confinement call, or the confinement call precedes the --version return
check.pseudocode:
pos = positions(parse(cmdDir), roots=['main'])
assert pos.parseFlags < pos.versionReturn < pos.confine
for p in pos.redirectStdout ∪ pos.agentNew ∪ pos.goStmts: assert pos.confine < p
assert len(pos.confineCalls)==1
for src in badSources: err = checkOrder(src); assert err!=nil && matches(err, file+':'+line)

criteria.action: pass the outcome of confinement to the agent as data through the new field agent.Config.Landlock of type sandbox.LandlockInfo, applying the ruleset to the agent's own process so that every process a tool starts inherits it
criteria.contract: on Linux with k >= 2: ABI == min(k, 4), KernelABI == k and Writable contains the resolved W; with k < 2 or a probe error: ABI 0 and Plan's note; on macOS: ABI 0 and `Landlock is Linux-only (GOOS=darwin)`; when ABI is above 0 the grandchild's write fails, the execute result reports a non-zero exit, and S/f does not exist on the host; the agent.Config literal in the command's source sets the Landlock field from the confinement outcome (AST check)

setup: the agentkit-sandboxd binary built into t.TempDir(), started over pipes with --workdir W and HOME, TMPDIR and PATH=/usr/bin:/bin in cmd.Env
the test's independent probe of the kernel ABI k, and a sibling directory S outside every root
check.pseudocode:
p = start(bin,'--workdir',W, env); sb = attachTo(p); l = sb.Agent().Landlock
if linux && k>=2: assert l.ABI==min(k,4) && l.KernelABI==k && resolve(W) ∈ l.Writable
elif linux: assert l.ABI==0 && l.Note==Plan(k,perr,none).Note
else: assert l.ABI==0 && l.Note=='Landlock is Linux-only (GOOS='+runtime.GOOS+')'
if l.ABI>0: r = execute(sb,`/bin/sh -c '/bin/sh -c "echo x > S/f"'`); assert r.exit!=0 && !exists(S+'/f')
assert agentConfigLiteralSets(cmdSrc,'Landlock')

criteria.action: for any effective spec, make sandbox.AgentArgs(spec Spec) []string return `--ttl <spec.TTL>`, `--network <spec.Network.Mode>` and, only when spec.Workdir is non-empty, `--workdir <spec.Workdir>`
criteria.contract: parsing AgentArgs(spec) with the command's parseFlags yields the spec's TTL and network mode, and its Workdir when set, else the command's default workdir

setup: a test in the command's package with access to parseFlags and sandbox.AgentArgs

a seeded generator of effective specs: TTL a positive duration from 1s to 48h (including non-round values), Mode one of none, allowlist and unrestricted, Workdir empty or an absolute path under t.TempDir()
check.pseudocode:
for seed in 1..500: spec = genEffective(seed); args = sandbox.AgentArgs(spec)
  cfg,err = parseFlags(args); assert err==nil && cfg.TTL==spec.TTL && cfg.Network==spec.Network.Mode
  assert cfg.Workdir == (spec.Workdir!='' ? spec.Workdir : '/workspace')
  assert follows(args,'--ttl',spec.TTL.String()) && follows(args,'--network',spec.Network.Mode.String()) && contains(args,'--workdir')==(spec.Workdir!='')

requirements.title: Reporting the applied ruleset
requirements.rationale: The embedder can only enforce what it can see, so the agent reports field by field what it applied and the host never guesses.

criteria.action: add `LandlockReport landlock = 7` to HelloResponse, with message LandlockReport { uint32 abi = 1; uint32 kernel_abi = 2; bool tcp = 3; string note = 4; repeated string writable = 5; repeated string read_only = 6; }, and regenerate the checked-in sandboxpb code and its hash file with `make proto`
criteria.contract: `make proto` on a clean tree leaves no diff

setup: the checked-in sandbox/internal/sandboxpb generated code and its hash file
check.pseudocode:
h = msg('HelloResponse'); f = h.Fields().ByNumber(7); assert f.Name()=='landlock' && f.Message().Name()=='LandlockReport'
lr = msg('LandlockReport'); assert fields(lr) == [(abi,1,uint32,single),(kernel_abi,2,uint32,single),(tcp,3,bool,single),(note,4,string,single),(writable,5,string,repeated),(read_only,6,string,repeated)]
t.Setenv('PATH',''); assert checkProtoHash(read('sandbox.proto'), read(hashFile))==nil

criteria.action: set ProtocolMinor to 2 and leave ProtocolMajor unchanged
criteria.contract: TS-14-5 and every test that pinned minor 1 pin 2; TS-13-24 expects `1.2`

setup: a local.Unisolated() sandbox; TS-14-5 and every test that pinned minor 1 updated to pin 2
check.pseudocode:
assert sandbox.ProtocolMajor==1 && sandbox.ProtocolMinor==2
sb = local.Unisolated().Create(ctx, Spec{Network:{Mode:NetworkUnrestricted}}); assert sb.Agent().ProtocolMajor==1 && sb.Agent().ProtocolMinor==2
for minor in [0,1]: _,err = attach.New(ctx, cfgOver(fakeagent.WithHello(1,minor))); assert err==nil

criteria.action: export type LandlockInfo struct { ABI int; KernelABI int; TCP bool; Note string; Writable []string; ReadOnly []string }, the constants LandlockMinABI = 2 and LandlockTCPABI = 4, and the field AgentInfo.Landlock of type LandlockInfo
criteria.contract: LandlockInfo's fields are, in order, ABI int, KernelABI int, TCP bool, Note string, Writable []string and ReadOnly []string; sandbox.LandlockMinABI == 2 and sandbox.LandlockTCPABI == 4; AgentInfo has a field Landlock of type sandbox.LandlockInfo

setup: package sandbox inspected with reflect
check.pseudocode:
rt = reflect.TypeOf(sandbox.LandlockInfo{}); assert fieldsOf(rt)==[('ABI',int),('KernelABI',int),('TCP',bool),('Note',string),('Writable',[]string),('ReadOnly',[]string)]
assert sandbox.LandlockMinABI==2 && sandbox.LandlockTCPABI==4
f,ok = reflect.TypeOf(sandbox.AgentInfo{}).FieldByName('Landlock'); assert ok && f.Type==rt

criteria.action: for any LandlockInfo l and NetworkMode m, make l.Satisfies(m) true exactly when l.ABI >= LandlockMinABI and, when m is NetworkNone, l.TCP is also true
criteria.contract: returns a bool

setup: a seeded generator of LandlockInfo values (ABI from -1 to 10, KernelABI from 0 to 10, random TCP, Note, Writable and ReadOnly) and of NetworkModes

criteria.condition: the agent answers Hello
criteria.action: return agent.Config.Landlock as HelloResponse.landlock field for field, and have attach fill AgentInfo.Landlock from that report field for field
criteria.contract: Sandbox.Agent().Landlock equals the LandlockInfo the command passed to agent.New

setup: agent.New with Config{Workdir: t.TempDir(), TTL: time.Hour, Landlock: L} served over net.Pipe, with L = {ABI 3, KernelABI 5, TCP false, Note "n", Writable [/w1, /w2, /dev/null], ReadOnly [/usr, /proc]}
a second agent built with the zero LandlockInfo
a raw sandboxpb.AgentClient and attach.Dial over the same kind of pipe
check.pseudocode:
a = agent.New(agent.Config{..., Landlock:L}); raw = clientOver(a); h = raw.Hello(ctx,{})
assert (h.Landlock.Abi,h.Landlock.KernelAbi,h.Landlock.Tcp,h.Landlock.Note,h.Landlock.Writable,h.Landlock.ReadOnly)==(3,5,false,'n',L.Writable,L.ReadOnly)
sb = attach.Dial(...a...); assert reflect.DeepEqual(sb.Agent().Landlock, L)
